name: The Shakedown
_comment: 012, rebuilt in 088 (A15): the tutorial's board, never a run's (RunSim skips `tutorial` fights). Laid out so the coached line (data/tutorial.json) plays every signature verb in round 1: the Yard Gunner and the Runner Boss aim lances through Relay (6 damage, all its HP: a real threat); Needle's lance kills the Gunner first (4 HP: its intent is CANCELLED); Knuckles walks to (2,4) and hammers the Yard Runner (6 HP, 4 damage: no tear) into the pit at (3,2); Relay pays 1 heat for FOCUS and its Scattergun tears the Runner Boss's lance (5+ tears; without FOCUS it falls short). Knuckles wears Ablative Plating, not the Scavenger Rig: two Cinder parts would give +1 melee and the hammer would tear the runner too. The Boss carries 10 HP so it stands into round 2 with one arm. Enemy moves and intents are the AI's own, fixed by the tutorial seed: re-check them with verify_onboarding after any rules change.
